description: Java source code for LoraProtocolAdapter class, a Vert.x based HTTP protocol adapter for LoRa backend communication, including route setup, authentication, message handling, and tracing.

classes.name: LoraProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x based HTTP protocol adapter for LoRa backend communication, handling routing, authentication, message processing, and tracing.

methods.name: setLoraProviders
methods.description: Sets the list of supported LoraProvider instances.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the authentication provider for username/password device authentication.

methods.name: setClientCertAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the authentication provider for client certificate device authentication.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the protocol adapter type name.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Configures HTTP routes for the adapter, including authorization and provider-specific endpoints.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Adds properties to the downstream message based on context data.

methods.name: handleProviderRoute
methods.description: Processes incoming provider messages, extracts data, and handles message forwarding or errors.

methods.name: getCurrentSpan
methods.description: Retrieves the current tracing span from the routing context.

methods.name: handleOptionsRoute
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS HTTP requests for health checks or CORS preflight.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Uploads telemetry data to the backend, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: handle202
methods.description: Responds with HTTP 202 status, indicating accepted processing.
